parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols cfm version standard.explanation: 配置CFM协议的版本为标准版本。

set protocols cfm ethernet-switching dom.template: set protocols cfm ethernet-switching domain [parameter1] level [parameter2]
set protocols cfm ethernet-switching dom.command: set protocols cfm ethernet-switching domain md1 level 0
set protocols cfm ethernet-switching dom.explanation: 配置CFM以太网交换域的级别。

set protocols cfm ethernet-switching ser.template: set protocols cfm ethernet-switching service [parameter1] vlan [parameter2]
set protocols cfm ethernet-switching ser.command: set protocols cfm ethernet-switching service ma1 vlan 2
set protocols cfm ethernet-switching ser.explanation: 配置CFM以太网交换服务与VLAN的关联。

parameters.name: service
parameters.explanation: CFM以太网交换服务的名称。

set protocols cfm ethernet-switching con.command: set protocols cfm ethernet-switching continuity-check enable
set protocols cfm ethernet-switching con.explanation: 启用CFM以太网交换的连续性检查功能。

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: 启用或禁用连续性检查功能。

set protocols cfm ethernet-switching con.template: set protocols cfm ethernet-switching continuity-check mep-id [parameter1] interface [parameter2] direction [parameter3]
set protocols cfm ethernet-switching con.command: set protocols cfm ethernet-switching continuity-check mep-id 2 interface ge-0/0/1 direction outward
set protocols cfm ethernet-switching con.explanation: 配置CFM以太网交换的连续性检查的MEP ID、接口和方向。

set protocols cfm ethernet-switching con.template: set protocols cfm ethernet-switching continuity-check remote-mep [parameter1]
set protocols cfm ethernet-switching con.command: set protocols cfm ethernet-switching continuity-check remote-mep 1
set protocols cfm ethernet-switching con.explanation: 配置CFM以太网交换的连续性检查的远程MEP ID。

set protocols cfm ethernet-switching con.template: set protocols cfm ethernet-switching continuity-check receive [parameter1] remote-mep [parameter2]
set protocols cfm ethernet-switching con.command: set protocols cfm ethernet-switching continuity-check receive enable remote-mep 1
set protocols cfm ethernet-switching con.explanation: 启用CFM以太网交换的连续性检查接收功能，并指定远程MEP ID。

set protocols cfm ethernet-switching con.template: set protocols cfm ethernet-switching continuity-check loss-measurement [parameter1] [parameter2]
set protocols cfm ethernet-switching con.command: set protocols cfm ethernet-switching continuity-check loss-measurement single-ended enable
set protocols cfm ethernet-switching con.explanation: 启用CFM以太网交换的连续性检查的单端丢失测量功能。

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: 启用或禁用丢失测量功能。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching interface-mode [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching interface-mode trunk
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换模式为trunk。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching vlan members [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members vlan2
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换VLAN成员。
